-- Freecam Script for Roblox (Persistent Executor Version)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Variables to keep track of current character state
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)

local freecamEnabled = false
local speed = 240 -- Camera movement speed
local sensitivity = 0.6 -- Mouse sensitivity

-- Store original settings
local originalWalkSpeed = humanoid and humanoid.WalkSpeed or 16
local originalJumpPower = humanoid and humanoid.JumpPower or 50

-- Camera rotation variables
local rotationX = 0
local rotationY = 0

-- Movement keys
local keys = {
    W = false,
    A = false,
    S = false,
    D = false,
    Q = false, -- Down
    E = false, -- Up
    LeftShift = false -- Speed boost
}

-- Function to safely reset camera
local function resetCameraToDefault()
    Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    
    local currentHumanoid = character or (player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
    if currentHumanoid then
        Camera.CameraSubject = currentHumanoid
    end
    
    UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
    UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
    
    if character and character.Parent then
        local currentRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local currentHumanoidObj = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if currentRoot then currentRoot.Anchored = false end
        if currentHumanoidObj then
            currentHumanoidObj.WalkSpeed = originalWalkSpeed or 16
            currentHumanoidObj.JumpPower = originalJumpPower or 50
        end
    end
    
    for key, _ in pairs(keys) do
        keys[key] = false
    end
    
    freecamEnabled = false
end

-- Function to enable freecam
local function enableFreecam()
    if not character or not character.Parent then return end
    
    freecamEnabled = true
    Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
    UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
    
    local x, y, z = Camera.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
    rotationX = x
    rotationY = y
    
    local currentRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local currentHumanoidObj = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if currentRoot then currentRoot.Anchored = true end
    if currentHumanoidObj then
        currentHumanoidObj.WalkSpeed = 0
        currentHumanoidObj.JumpPower = 0
    end
end

-- Track key presses
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
        if freecamEnabled then
            resetCameraToDefault()
        else
            enableFreecam()
        end
    end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R and input:IsModifierKeyDown(Enum.ModifierKey.Ctrl) then
        resetCameraToDefault()
        print("Emergency camera reset activated!")
    end
    
    if freecamEnabled and keys[input.KeyCode.Name] ~= nil then
        keys[input.KeyCode.Name] = true
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if keys[input.KeyCode.Name] ~= nil then
        keys[input.KeyCode.Name] = false
    end
end)

-- Mouse movement for camera rotation
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not freecamEnabled then return end
    
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        local delta = input.Delta
        rotationY = rotationY - delta.X * sensitivity * 0.01
        rotationX = rotationX - delta.Y * sensitivity * 0.01
        rotationX = math.clamp(rotationX, -math.pi/2 + 0.01, math.pi/2 - 0.01)
    end
end)

-- Update camera position
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    if not freecamEnabled then return end
    
    if UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
    end
    
    local movementSpeed = speed
    if keys.LeftShift then
        movementSpeed = speed * 2
    end
    
    local cameraRotation = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(rotationX, rotationY, 0)
    local moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    
    if keys.W then moveVector = moveVector + (cameraRotation * CFrame.new(0, 0, -1)).Position end
    if keys.S then moveVector = moveVector + (cameraRotation * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1)).Position end
    if keys.A then moveVector = moveVector + (cameraRotation * CFrame.new(-1, 0, 0)).Position end
    if keys.D then moveVector = moveVector + (cameraRotation * CFrame.new(1, 0, 0)).Position end
    if keys.E then moveVector = moveVector + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    if keys.Q then moveVector = moveVector - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    
    if moveVector.Magnitude > 0 then
        moveVector = moveVector.Unit
    end
    
    local newPosition = Camera.CFrame.Position + moveVector * movementSpeed * deltaTime
    Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPosition) * cameraRotation
end)

-- CRITICAL FIX: Automatically update variables when you respawn, without breaking the script loops
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
    freecamEnabled = false
    character = newCharacter
    humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
    rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
    
    if humanoid then
        originalWalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
        originalJumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower
    end
end)

local function PDDUG_fake_script() -- Frame.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Frame)

	local frame = script.Parent
	local userInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	
	local dragging = false
	local dragInput
	local dragStart
	local startPos
	
	local function update(input)
		if not dragging then return end
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
	
	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position
	
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)
	
	userInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input == dragInput then
			update(input)
		end

-- ==========================================

    if obj:IsA("Sky") or obj:IsA("Atmosphere") or obj:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then obj:Destroy() end
end
Lighting.FogEnd = 1000000

local currentSky = Instance.new("Sky")
currentSky.Name = "SkyboxLayer"
currentSky.Parent = Lighting

local CC = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
CC.Parent = Lighting

local function setSkyTexture(id)
    local tex = id and ("rbxassetid://" .. id) or ""
    currentSky.SkyboxBk = tex; currentSky.SkyboxDn = tex
    currentSky.SkyboxFt = tex; currentSky.SkyboxLf = tex
    currentSky.SkyboxRt = tex; currentSky.SkyboxUp = tex
end

local LAYERS = {
    {name="Ground", studs=0, sky=nil, sound=nil, pitch=1, effect="none"},
    {name="1. Null Zone", studs=50000, sky=nil, sound=nil, pitch=1, effect="flicker"},
    {name="2. Black Box", studs=1000000, sky="1864839162", sound="9125603749", pitch=1, effect="none"},
    {name="3. Color Box", studs=1500000, sky="76584711398016", sound="103640130374819", pitch=1, effect="rgb"},
    {name="4. Glitch Box", studs=2000000, sky="678675390", sound="74461673136220", pitch=1, effect="glitch"},
    {name="5. Red Box", studs=5000000, sky="136055162054954", sound="1844251170", pitch=1, effect="red"},
    {name="6. Gall Box", studs=10000000, sky="348361280", sound="140449240163331", pitch=1, effect="green"},
    {name="7. Fritch Box", studs=15000000, sky="14201658516", sound="133054925243074", pitch=1, effect="none"},
    {name="8. True Void Box", studs=25000000, sky="1864839162", sound=nil, pitch=1, effect="dark"},
    {name="9. Noise Box", studs=35000000, sky="132436343179109", sound="9043345732", pitch=10, effect="noise"},
    {name="10. Blue Box", studs=50000000, sky="1864839162", sound="105560583824086", pitch=1, effect="blue"},
    {name="11. Scream Box", studs=65000000, sky="136055162054954", sound=nil, pitch=1, effect="darkred"},
    {name="12. White Box", studs=75000000, sky="4604073339", sound="86575433206430", pitch=1, effect="white"},
    {name="13. Time Box", studs=100000000, sky="1276339885", sound="113002664483925", pitch=2, effect="time"},
    {name="14. Space Box", studs=150000000, sky="136402262", sound="139992348741850", pitch=1, effect="space"},
    {name="15. Final Box", studs=250000000, sky="409857582", sound="9125603019", pitch=1, effect="none"}
}

-- ==========================================
-- 6. SPACE ENGINE (LAYER 14) DEBRIS SYSTEM
-- ==========================================
local SpaceFolder = Instance.new("Folder", workspace)
SpaceFolder.Name = "SpaceDebrisEngine"
local DebrisPool = {}

for i = 1, 70 do
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Size = Vector3.new(math.random(2,8), math.random(2,8), math.random(2,8))
    part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 255)
    part.Anchored = true; part.CanCollide = false
    part.Transparency = 1 -- Sembunyikan secara default
    part.Parent = SpaceFolder
    table.insert(DebrisPool, {obj = part, offsetY = math.random(-500, 500)})
end

-- ==========================================
-- 7. CORE ENGINE (FLY & EFFECTS LOOP)
-- ==========================================
local isFlying = false
local flySpeed = 5000
local activeLayerIndex = -1
local effectTimer = 0

FlyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isFlying = not isFlying
    FlyBtn.Text = isFlying and "STOP ASCEND" or "START ASCEND (SIT)"
    FlyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = isFlying and Color3.fromRGB(40, 180, 40) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
end)

SpeedBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local val = tonumber(SpeedBox.Text)
    if val then flySpeed = math.clamp(val, 10, 500000) end
    SpeedBox.Text = tostring(flySpeed)
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp then return end

    -- Update UI Distance
    local altitude = math.floor(hrp.Position.Y)
    DistanceLabel.Text = "Altitude: " .. altitude .. " Studs"
    ProgressBar.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(altitude / 250000000, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)

    -- Fly Logic
    if isFlying then
        if hum then hum.Sit = true end
        for _, p in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end end
        hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, flySpeed * dt, 0)
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end

    -- Layer Checker
    local currentIdx = 1
    for i = #LAYERS, 1, -1 do
        if altitude >= LAYERS[i].studs then currentIdx = i break end
    end

    local curData = LAYERS[currentIdx]

    -- Trigger saat ganti layer
    if activeLayerIndex ~= currentIdx then
        activeLayerIndex = currentIdx
        LayerLabel.Text = "Zone: " .. curData.name
        setSkyTexture(curData.sky)

        -- Reset Color Correction
        CC.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        if curData.effect == "red" then CC.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
        elseif curData.effect == "green" then CC.TintColor = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)
        elseif curData.effect == "blue" then CC.TintColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 1)
        elseif curData.effect == "darkred" then CC.TintColor = Color3.new(0.3, 0, 0)
        elseif curData.effect == "dark" then CC.TintColor = Color3.new(0.02, 0.02, 0.02)
        elseif curData.effect == "white" then CC.TintColor = Color3.new(2, 2, 2)
        end

        -- Update Audio System
        if curData.sound then
            BGSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. curData.sound
            BGSound.PlaybackSpeed = curData.pitch
            if not BGSound.IsPlaying then BGSound:Play() end
        else
            BGSound:Stop()
        end

        -- Sembunyikan partikel luar angkasa jika bukan layer 14
        if curData.effect ~= "space" then
            for _, d in pairs(DebrisPool) do d.obj.Transparency = 1 end
        end
    end

    -- =================================
    -- UNIQUE LAYER EFFECTS (REALTIME)
    -- =================================
    effectTimer = effectTimer + dt

    if curData.effect == "flicker" then
        CC.TintColor = (math.floor(effectTimer * 15) % 2 == 0) and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Color3.new(0,0,0)

    elseif curData.effect == "rgb" then
        CC.TintColor = Color3.fromHSV(effectTimer % 3 / 3, 1, 1)

    elseif curData.effect == "glitch" then
        if math.random(1, 10) > 8 then
            setSkyTexture(math.random(1,2) == 1 and "678675390" or "409857582")
        end

    elseif curData.effect == "noise" then
        -- Setiap 1 detik ganti Abu-abu & Merah
        local isRed = math.floor(effectTimer) % 2 == 0
        CC.TintColor = isRed and Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)

    elseif curData.effect == "time" then
        -- Sisi skybox berubah-ubah ke {142900882}
        if math.random(1, 30) > 27 then
            local faces = {"SkyboxBk", "SkyboxDn", "SkyboxFt", "SkyboxLf", "SkyboxRt", "SkyboxUp"}
            local targetFace = faces[math.random(1, 6)]
            currentSky[targetFace] = "rbxassetid://142900882"
            
            task.delay(0.15, function()
                if activeLayerIndex == 14 then -- 14 = Time Box (Layer 13 tp index array 14 krn ground)
                    currentSky[targetFace] = "rbxassetid://1276339885"
                end
            end)
        end

    elseif curData.effect == "space" then
        -- Space Box Debris: Part berterbangan ke bawah (Ilusi Player naik)
        for _, d in pairs(DebrisPool) do
            d.obj.Transparency = 0.2
            -- Partikel jatuh sesuai dengan kecepatan terbang player
            d.offsetY = d.offsetY - (math.clamp(flySpeed, 100, 2000) * dt)
            
            -- Jika part sudah menjauh 500 stud di bawah player, spawn kembali di atas
            if d.offsetY < -500 then
                d.offsetY = 500 + math.random(0, 300)
                d.obj.Position = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-300, 300), d.offsetY, math.random(-300, 300))
            else
                -- Turunkan Y secara halus
                d.obj.CFrame = CFrame.new(d.obj.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y + d.offsetY, d.obj.Position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(d.offsetY/10, d.offsetY/10, 0)
            end
        end
    end
end)

scripts.script:
-- XploitHub.lua -- merged ESP + Aimbot with XPLOIT-style clean UI
-- ESP: Boxes / Tracers / Names / Distance / Health / Chams (Highlight)
-- Aim: hold-RMB camera lock with FOV + silent-aim helper for YOUR OWN tools
-- Use only in your own games / Studio testing. Live exploiting = ban.
-- Execute: copy entire file into executor -> Execute

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
assert(LocalPlayer, "[XPLOIT] No LocalPlayer - run as client")
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

local Settings = {
    -- ESP
    ESPEnabled = true,
    Boxes = true,
    Tracers = false,
    Names = true,
    Distance = true,
    HealthBar = true,
    HealthText = false,
    Chams = true,
    -- Aim
    AimbotEnabled = false, -- hold RMB to lock
    SilentAimEnabled = false,
    ShowFOV = true,
    WallCheck = true,
    -- Shared
    TeamCheck = true,
    ShowTeamColors = true,
    FOV = 120,
    Smoothing = 8,
    TargetPart = "Head", -- Head | HumanoidRootPart | Closest
    Prediction = 0,      -- 0 .. 0.30
    SilentHitChance = 100,
    MaxDistance = 2000,  -- 0 = infinite
    AimKey = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2,
    BoxColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50),
    FriendlyColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 255, 100),
}

local hasDrawing = typeof(Drawing) == "table" and typeof(Drawing.new) == "function"
local RED = Color3.fromRGB(220, 45, 55)
local BG = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
local PANEL = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 32)
local DIM = Color3.fromRGB(175, 175, 190)
local BRIGHT = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245)

--// parent
local function getParent()
    local ok, h = pcall(function()
        if typeof(gethui) == "function" then return gethui() end
        if typeof(get_hidden_gui) == "function" then return get_hidden_gui() end
        return nil
    end)
    if ok and h then return h end
    return LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
end
local Parent = getParent()
assert(Parent, "[XPLOIT] no parent GUI found")
pcall(function() Parent:FindFirstChild("XploitHub"):Destroy() end)

local function new(class, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do pcall(function() o[k] = v end) end
    o.Parent = parent
    return o
end

local gui = new("ScreenGui", {
    Name = "XploitHub", ResetOnSpawn = false,
    IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 999,
    ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
}, Parent)
if typeof(protect_gui) == "function" then pcall(protect_gui, gui) end

--// main window (XPLOIT look: dark, red title, 2 columns)
local main = new("Frame", {
    Name = "Main", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(440, 430),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -220, 0.5, -215),
    BackgroundColor3 = BG, Active = true,
}, gui)
new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }, main)
new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 20, 25), Transparency = 0.1 }, main)

local titleBar = new("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, main)
local title = new("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = "XPLOIT", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 15,
    TextColor3 = RED,
}, titleBar)
new("Frame", { -- red divider under title
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 33),
    BackgroundColor3 = RED, BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
}, titleBar)
local minBtn = new("TextButton", {
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 22), Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 6),
    BackgroundColor3 = PANEL, Text = "-", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14,
    TextColor3 = BRIGHT, AutoButtonColor = true,
}, titleBar)
new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, minBtn)

local cols = new("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -88), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 40),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, main)
local left = new("ScrollingFrame", {
    Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    ScrollBarThickness = 3, AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
    CanvasSize = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
}, cols)
new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, left)
new("UIPadding", { PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6) }, left)
local right = new("ScrollingFrame", {
    Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    ScrollBarThickness = 3, AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
    CanvasSize = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
}, cols)
new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, right)
new("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6) }, right)

local footer = new("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 40), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -46),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, main)
local unloadBtn = new("TextButton", {
    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.62), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 25, 30),
    Text = "Unload", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,
    TextColor3 = BRIGHT, AutoButtonColor = true,
}, footer)
new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, unloadBtn)
local hint = new("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.66),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "RightShift: UI  |  RMB hold: aim  |  Q: silent  |  Del: unload",
    Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = DIM,
}, footer)

--// builders (match screenshot: red section header, dot toggles, - value + steppers)
local function section(parent, text)
    local s = new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 11,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextColor3 = RED,
    }, parent)
    new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
        BackgroundColor3 = RED, BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundTransparency = 0.6,
    }, s)
    return s
end

local function refreshToggle(btn, dot, label, on)
    btn.Text = "  •  " .. label
    dot.BackgroundColor3 = on and RED or Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 85)
end

local function toggle(parent, label, key)
    local b = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL,
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextColor3 = BRIGHT, AutoButtonColor = true,
    }, parent)
    new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, b)
    local dot = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, -3),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 85), BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, b)
    new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, dot)
    refreshToggle(b, dot, label, Settings[key])
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Settings[key] = not Settings[key]
        refreshToggle(b, dot, label, Settings[key])
    end)
    return b
end

local function slider(parent, label, key, smin, smax, step, fmt)
    fmt = fmt or function(v) return tostring(v) end
    local row = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL,
    }, parent)
    new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, row)
    new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "  •  " .. label,
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = BRIGHT,
    }, row)
    local minus = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(1, -64, 0.5, -8),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 52), Text = "-",
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = BRIGHT,
        AutoButtonColor = true,
    }, row)
    new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) }, minus)
    local val = new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(1, -42, 0.5, -8),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = fmt(Settings[key]),
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = RED,
    }, row)
    local plus = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0.5, -8),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 52), Text = "+",
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = BRIGHT,
        AutoButtonColor = true,
    }, row)
    new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) }, plus)
    local function set(v)
        v = math.clamp(math.floor(v / step + 0.5) * step, smin, smax)
        -- Prediction uses decimals, don't snap harshly
        if step < 1 then v = math.clamp(v, smin, smax) end
        Settings[key] = v
        val.Text = fmt(v)
    end
    minus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() set(Settings[key] - step) end)
    plus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() set(Settings[key] + step) end)
    return row
end

local function cycle(parent, label, key, options)
    local b = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL,
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextColor3 = BRIGHT, AutoButtonColor = true,
    }, parent)
    new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, b)
    local function paint()
        b.Text = "  •  " .. label .. ":  " .. tostring(Settings[key])
    end
    paint()
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local idx = 1
        for i, o in ipairs(options) do if o == Settings[key] then idx = i break end end
        Settings[key] = options[(idx % #options) + 1]
        paint()
    end)
    return b
end

-- LEFT column (like screenshot left side)
section(left, "ESP")
toggle(left, "Enabled", "ESPEnabled")
toggle(left, "Boxes", "Boxes")
toggle(left, "Tracers", "Tracers")
toggle(left, "Names", "Names")
toggle(left, "Distance", "Distance")
toggle(left, "Health bar", "HealthBar")
toggle(left, "Health text", "HealthText")
toggle(left, "Chams", "Chams")

section(left, "AIM")
toggle(left, "Aimbot (hold RMB)", "AimbotEnabled")
toggle(left, "Silent aim", "SilentAimEnabled")
toggle(left, "Show FOV", "ShowFOV")
toggle(left, "Wall check", "WallCheck")

-- RIGHT column (like screenshot right side)
section(right, "AIM TUNE")
slider(right, "FOV", "FOV", 30, 400, 5, function(v) return tostring(math.floor(v)) end)
slider(right, "Smooth", "Smoothing", 1, 20, 1, function(v) return tostring(math.floor(v)) end)
cycle(right, "Bone", "TargetPart", { "Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "Closest" })
slider(right, "Predict", "Prediction", 0, 0.3, 0.01, function(v) return string.format("%.2f", v) end)
slider(right, "Hit %", "SilentHitChance", 1, 100, 1, function(v) return tostring(math.floor(v)) end)

section(right, "SETTINGS")
toggle(right, "Team check", "TeamCheck")
toggle(right, "Team colors", "ShowTeamColors")
slider(right, "Max dist", "MaxDistance", 0, 5000, 100, function(v)
    if v == 0 then return "inf" end
    return tostring(math.floor(v))
end)

--// shared targeting logic
local function isFriendly(p)
    if not Settings.TeamCheck then return false end
    local ok, r = pcall(function()
        return LocalPlayer.Team ~= nil and p.Team ~= nil and LocalPlayer.Team == p.Team
    end)
    return ok and r == true
end

local function espColor(p)
    if Settings.ShowTeamColors then
        local ok, c = pcall(function() return p.TeamColor.Color end)
        if ok and c then return c end
    end
    if isFriendly(p) then return Settings.FriendlyColor end
    return Settings.BoxColor
end

local function wallClear(targetPos, targetChar)
    if not Settings.WallCheck then return true end
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { LocalPlayer.Character, targetChar }
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    return Workspace:Raycast(origin, targetPos - origin, params) == nil
end

local function getTargetPart(char)
    if Settings.TargetPart == "Head" then return char:FindFirstChild("Head") end
    if Settings.TargetPart == "HumanoidRootPart" then return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if head and hrp then
        local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        local hp = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
        local rp = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
        local hd = (Vector2.new(hp.X, hp.Y) - m).Magnitude
        local rd = (Vector2.new(rp.X, rp.Y) - m).Magnitude
        if hd < rd then return head else return hrp end
    end
    return head or hrp
end

local function distToLocal(hrp)
    local my = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not my then return 0 end
    return (hrp.Position - my.Position).Magnitude
end

local function closestTarget()
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera then return nil, nil end
    local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local best, bestD, bestPos = nil, Settings.FOV, nil
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p == LocalPlayer or isFriendly(p) then continue end
        local char = p.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then continue end
        local part = getTargetPart(char)
        if not part then continue end
        local aimPos = part.Position
        if Settings.Prediction > 0 then
            local ok, vel = pcall(function() return part.AssemblyLinearVelocity end)
            if ok and vel then aimPos = aimPos + vel * Settings.Prediction end
        end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp and Settings.MaxDistance > 0 and distToLocal(hrp) > Settings.MaxDistance then continue end
        local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(aimPos)
        if not onScreen then continue end
        local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - mouse).Magnitude
        if d < bestD and wallClear(aimPos, char) then
            best, bestD, bestPos = p, d, aimPos
        end
    end
    return best, bestPos
end

local function silentShouldHit()
    return math.random(1, 100) <= Settings.SilentHitChance
end

-- expose for YOUR OWN tool scripts (silent aim done right: redirect your own ray):
--   local g = getgenv()
--   local target, pos = g.XploitClosestTarget()
--   if target and pos and g.XploitSilentFire() then
--     dir = (pos - origin).Unit * 1000
--   else
--     dir = (mouse.Hit.Position - origin).Unit * 1000
--   end
pcall(function()
    local g = getgenv and getgenv() or nil
    if g then
        g.XploitClosestTarget = closestTarget
        g.XploitSilentFire = function()
            return Settings.SilentAimEnabled and silentShouldHit()
        end
        g.XploitSettings = Settings
    end
end)

--// ESP objects
local espObjects = {}
local function hideDrawings(e)
    if e.drawings then for _, d in pairs(e.drawings) do pcall(function() d.Visible = false end) end end
    if e.fov then pcall(function() e.fov.Visible = false end) end
end
local function clearPlayer(p)
    local e = espObjects[p]
    if not e then return end
    pcall(function() e.highlight:Destroy() end)
    pcall(function() e.billboard:Destroy() end)
    hideDrawings(e)
    if e.drawings then for _, d in pairs(e.drawings) do pcall(function() d:Remove() end) end end
    espObjects[p] = nil
end
local function setupPlayer(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end
    if espObjects[player] then clearPlayer(player) end
    local e = { drawings = {} }
    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
    hl.Name = "X_ESP"
    hl.FillTransparency = 0.6
    hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
    hl.Parent = gui
    e.highlight = hl
    local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    bb.Name = "X_Name"
    bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 40)
    bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
    bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
    bb.MaxDistance = math.huge
    bb.Parent = gui
    local nl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    nl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    nl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    nl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    nl.TextSize = 13
    nl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    nl.Parent = bb
    e.billboard = bb
    e.nameLabel = nl
    if hasDrawing then
        local box = Drawing.new("Square") box.Thickness = 1 box.Filled = false box.Visible = false box.ZIndex = 2
        local tr = Drawing.new("Line") tr.Thickness = 1 tr.Visible = false tr.ZIndex = 1
        local back = Drawing.new("Square") back.Filled = true back.Visible = false back.ZIndex = 1
        local bar = Drawing.new("Square") bar.Filled = true bar.Visible = false bar.ZIndex = 2
        e.drawings = { box = box, tracer = tr, hpBack = back, hpBar = bar }
    end
    espObjects[player] = e
    local function bind(char)
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
        local head = char:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
        if hum and hrp then
            e.highlight.Adornee = char
            e.billboard.Adornee = head or hrp
        end
    end
    if player.Character then task.spawn(bind, player.Character) end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.spawn(bind, c) end)
end
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do pcall(setupPlayer, p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(clearPlayer)

-- FOV ring
local fovCircle
if hasDrawing then
    fovCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
    fovCircle.Thickness = 1
    fovCircle.NumSides = 64
    fovCircle.Filled = false
    fovCircle.Color = RED
end

--// input: RightShift = UI, Q = silent, Del = unload, RMB hold = aim
local aiming = false
local conns = {}
local function unload()
    for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(conns)
    for p, _ in pairs(espObjects) do pcall(clearPlayer, p) end
    if fovCircle then pcall(function() fovCircle:Remove() end) end
    pcall(function()
        local g = getgenv and getgenv() or nil
        if g then g.XploitClosestTarget, g.XploitSilentFire = nil, nil end
    end)
    pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
    print("[XPLOIT] unloaded")
end
unloadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(unload)
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if gpe then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Settings.AimKey then aiming = true end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then Settings.SilentAimEnabled = not Settings.SilentAimEnabled end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then main.Visible = not main.Visible end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete then unload() end
end)
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Settings.AimKey then aiming = false end
end)
minBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() main.Visible = false end)

-- drag
do
    local dragging, sp, si = false, nil, nil
    titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging, sp, si = true, main.Position, i.Position
        end
    end)
    titleBar.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if not dragging then return end
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            local d = i.Position - si
            main.Position = UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale, sp.X.Offset + d.X, sp.Y.Scale, sp.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end)
end

local function tracerFrom()
    local vs = Camera.ViewportSize
    return Vector2.new(vs.X / 2, vs.Y)
end

--// single render loop: ESP + FOV + hard aimbot
conns[#conns + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not gui.Parent then return end
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera then return end

    if fovCircle then
        fovCircle.Position = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        fovCircle.Radius = Settings.FOV
        fovCircle.Visible = Settings.ShowFOV and Settings.AimbotEnabled
    end

    -- hard aimbot (camera lock while held)
    if Settings.AimbotEnabled and aiming then
        local _, pos = closestTarget()
        if pos then
            local cf = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, pos)
            Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(cf, math.clamp(Settings.Smoothing / 20, 0.05, 1))
        end
    end

    -- ESP
    for player, e in pairs(espObjects) do
        local ok = pcall(function()
            local char = player.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local valid = Settings.ESPEnabled and char and hum and hrp and head
                and hum.Health > 0 and not isFriendly(player)
            local dist = 0
            if hrp then dist = distToLocal(hrp) end
            if Settings.MaxDistance > 0 and dist > Settings.MaxDistance then valid = false end
            if not valid then
                e.highlight.Enabled = false
                e.billboard.Enabled = false
                hideDrawings(e)
                return
            end
            local color = espColor(player)
            e.highlight.Enabled = Settings.Chams
            if Settings.Chams then
                e.highlight.Adornee = char
                e.highlight.FillColor = color
                e.highlight.OutlineColor = color
            end
            local showText = Settings.Names or Settings.Distance or Settings.HealthText
            e.billboard.Enabled = showText
            if showText then
                e.billboard.Adornee = head
                local parts = {}
                if Settings.Names then table.insert(parts, player.DisplayName .. " (@" .. player.Name .. ")") end
                if Settings.Distance then table.insert(parts, "[" .. math.floor(dist) .. "m]") end
                if Settings.HealthText then table.insert(parts, math.ceil(hum.Health) .. " HP") end
                e.nameLabel.Text = table.concat(parts, " ")

scripts.script:
--============================================================
--  FLY (плавный, Homelander-style) + ESP + МЕНЮ
--  F — вкл/выкл полёт
--  WASD — движение, Space/Ctrl — вверх/вниз, Shift — буст x2
--============================================================

local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS        = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player     = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui  = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--============================================================
--  НАСТРОЙКИ
--============================================================
local FLY_SPEED         = 100
local FLY_ACCEL         = 10
local BOOST_MULT        = 2
local ESP_ON            = true
local ESP_FILL_COLOR    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
local ESP_OUTLINE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

-- ВСТАВЬ СВОИ ID АНИМАЦИЙ (см. инструкцию после скрипта)
local FLY_ANIM_ID    = "rbxassetid://0"  -- полёт (движение)
local HOVER_ANIM_ID  = "rbxassetid://0"  -- парение (стоит на месте)
local WIND_SOUND_ID  = "rbxassetid://3308152153" -- звук ветра (этот рабочий)

-- forward declarations
local menuFlyBtn, menuEspBtn

--============================================================
--  ESP
--============================================================
local function addHighlight(char)
    if not ESP_ON then return end
    if not char or not char:IsA("Model") then return end
    if char:FindFirstChild("ESPHighlight") then return end

    local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
    h.Name                = "ESPHighlight"
    h.FillColor           = ESP_FILL_COLOR
    h.OutlineColor        = ESP_OUTLINE_COLOR
    h.FillTransparency    = 0.5
    h.OutlineTransparency = 0
    h.DepthMode           = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    h.Parent              = char
end

local function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player and p.Character then
            local h = p.Character:FindFirstChild("ESPHighlight")
            if h then h:Destroy() end
        end
    end
end

local function hookPlayer(p)
    if p == player then return end
    if p.Character then addHighlight(p.Character) end
    p.CharacterAdded:Connect(addHighlight)
end

for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do hookPlayer(p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookPlayer)

local function setESP(state)
    ESP_ON = state
    if ESP_ON then
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= player and p.Character then addHighlight(p.Character) end
        end
    else
        removeAllHighlights()
    end
end

--============================================================
--  FLY
--============================================================
local flying, hrp, humanoid, att, lv, vf, spin, connFly
local currentVel = Vector3.zero
local flyAnimTrack, hoverAnimTrack, windSound
local isMoving = false
local loadedAnimator = nil

local function loadAnimations()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local animator = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if not animator then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            if not animator then
                animator = Instance.new("Animator")
                animator.Parent = hum
            end
        end
    end
    if not animator then return end
    loadedAnimator = animator

    local flyAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    flyAnim.AnimationId = FLY_ANIM_ID
    flyAnimTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(flyAnim)
    flyAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action

    local hoverAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    hoverAnim.AnimationId = HOVER_ANIM_ID
    hoverAnimTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(hoverAnim)
    hoverAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action

    if windSound then windSound:Destroy() end
    windSound = Instance.new("Sound")
    windSound.SoundId = WIND_SOUND_ID
    windSound.Looped = true
    windSound.Volume = 0.5
    windSound.Parent = hrp
end

local function stopFly()
    flying = false
    if connFly then connFly:Disconnect() connFly = nil end
    if lv  then lv:Destroy()  lv  = nil end
    if vf  then vf:Destroy()  vf  = nil end
    if spin then spin:Destroy() spin = nil end
    if att then att:Destroy() att = nil end

    if flyAnimTrack then flyAnimTrack:Stop() flyAnimTrack = nil end
    if hoverAnimTrack then hoverAnimTrack:Stop() hoverAnimTrack = nil end
    if windSound then windSound:Stop() windSound:Destroy() windSound = nil end

    if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
        humanoid.PlatformStand = false
        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    end

    hrp, humanoid = nil, nil
    currentVel = Vector3.zero
    isMoving = false
end

local function startFly()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    hrp      = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not humanoid then return end

    humanoid.PlatformStand = true
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)

    att = Instance.new("Attachment")
    att.Parent = hrp

    vf = Instance.new("VectorForce")
    vf.Attachment0 = att
    vf.RelativeTo  = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    vf.Force       = Vector3.new(0, workspace.Gravity * hrp.AssemblyMass, 0)
    vf.Parent      = hrp

    lv = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
    lv.Attachment0 = att
    lv.MaxForce    = math.huge
    lv.RelativeTo  = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    lv.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
    lv.Parent = hrp

    spin = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
    spin.Attachment0    = att
    spin.Mode           = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
    spin.MaxTorque      = math.huge
    spin.Responsiveness = 20
    spin.Parent         = hrp

    currentVel = Vector3.zero
    isMoving = false

    loadAnimations()

    if hoverAnimTrack then
        pcall(function() hoverAnimTrack:Play(0.2) end)
    end

    connFly = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not flying or not hrp or not hrp.Parent or not lv then return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end

        local look  = cam.CFrame.LookVector
        local right = cam.CFrame.RightVector

        local move = Vector3.zero
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move += look  end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move -= look  end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move += right end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move -= right end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)       then move += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then move -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end

        if move.Magnitude > 0 then move = move.Unit end

        local movingNow = move.Magnitude > 0
        if movingNow ~= isMoving then
            isMoving = movingNow
            if isMoving then
                if hoverAnimTrack then pcall(function() hoverAnimTrack:Stop(0.2) end) end
                if flyAnimTrack and not flyAnimTrack.IsPlaying then
                    pcall(function() flyAnimTrack:Play(0.2) end)
                end
            else
                if flyAnimTrack then pcall(function() flyAnimTrack:Stop(0.2) end) end
                if hoverAnimTrack and not hoverAnimTrack.IsPlaying then
                    pcall(function() hoverAnimTrack:Play(0.2) end)
                end
            end
        end

        if windSound then
            if movingNow and not windSound.IsPlaying then
                windSound:Play()
            elseif not movingNow and windSound.IsPlaying then
                windSound:Stop()
            end
        end

        local speed = FLY_SPEED
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)
        or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift) then
            speed *= BOOST_MULT
        end

        local targetVel = move * speed
        currentVel = currentVel:Lerp(targetVel, math.clamp(FLY_ACCEL * dt, 0, 1))
        lv.VectorVelocity = currentVel

        spin.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + look)
    end)
end

local COLOR_ON  = Color3.fromRGB(60, 180, 90)
local COLOR_OFF = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 60)

local function updateFlyUI()
    if not menuFlyBtn then return end
    menuFlyBtn.Text = flying and "Fly: ON" or "Fly: OFF"
    menuFlyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = flying and COLOR_ON or COLOR_OFF
end

local function updateEspUI()
    if not menuEspBtn then return end
    menuEspBtn.Text = ESP_ON and "ESP: ON" or "ESP: OFF"
    menuEspBtn.BackgroundColor3 = ESP_ON and COLOR_ON or COLOR_OFF
end

local function setFly(state)
    if state == flying then return end
    if state then
        flying = true
        startFly()
    else
        stopFly()
    end
    updateFlyUI()
end

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
        setFly(not flying)
    end
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    if flying then setFly(false) end
end)

--============================================================
--  МЕНЮ
--============================================================
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "FlyEspMenu"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

-- Modern Neon Minimalist UI (Fly + Noclip)

-- Clean up existing instances to prevent overlays
local existing = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("ModernCheatMenu") or (LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") and LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("ModernCheatMenu"))
if existing then existing:Destroy() end

-- Create Main Elements
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 18)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.35, 0)

MainFrame.Draggable = true

local UICorner_Main = Instance.new("UICorner")

UICorner_Main.Parent = MainFrame

local UIStroke_Main = Instance.new("UIStroke")

UIStroke_Main.Thickness = 1
UIStroke_Main.Parent = MainFrame

-- Header/Title Bar
local Header = Instance.new("Frame")
Header.Name = "Header"
Header.Parent = MainFrame
Header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Name = "Title"
Title.Parent = Header
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0)
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, 0)
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.Text = "FOREX TAB"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)
Title.TextSize = 14
Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

local Divider = Instance.new("Frame")
Divider.Name = "Divider"
Divider.Parent = MainFrame
Divider.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
Divider.BorderSizePixel = 0
Divider.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 45)
Divider.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 1)

-- Helper function to generate clean modern buttons
local function createFeatureButton(name, labelText, yPosition)
    local Container = Instance.new("Frame")
    Container.Name = name .. "Container"
    Container.Parent = MainFrame
    Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Container.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, yPosition)

    -- Visual Status Indicator Indicator Pill
    local Indicator = Instance.new("Frame")

    Indicator.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.5, -5)

    local IndCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

    return Button, Indicator
end

local FlyButton, FlyIndicator = createFeatureButton("Fly", "Toggle Flight Mode", 65)
local NoclipButton, NoclipIndicator = createFeatureButton("Noclip", "Toggle Noclip Mode", 120)

-- Interactive Speed Configuration Input
local SpeedContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
SpeedContainer.Name = "SpeedContainer"
SpeedContainer.Parent = MainFrame
SpeedContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
SpeedContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 185)
SpeedContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 42)

HintLabel.TextSize = 11

local Flying = false
local Noclipping = false
local FlySpeed = 50
local KeysPressed = {}
local NoclipConnection = nil

local BodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
BodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
BodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
BodyVelocity.Parent = RootPart

local BodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
BodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
BodyGyro.CFrame = RootPart.CFrame
BodyGyro.Parent = RootPart

local function updateReferences(newChar)
    Character = newChar
    Humanoid = Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    RootPart = Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    BodyVelocity.Parent = RootPart
    BodyGyro.Parent = RootPart
    if Flying then
        BodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(4e5, 4e5, 4e5)
        BodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(4e5, 4e5, 4e5)
        Humanoid.PlatformStand = true
    end
end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(updateReferences)

-- Smooth UI Color Transitions
local function tweenStatus(indicator, targetColor)
    TweenService:Create(indicator, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        BackgroundColor3 = targetColor
    }):Play()
end

local function toggleFly()
    Flying = not Flying
    if Flying then
        tweenStatus(FlyIndicator, Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94)) -- Smooth Emerald Green
        BodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(4e5, 4e5, 4e5)
        BodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(4e5, 4e5, 4e5)
        Humanoid.PlatformStand = true
    else
        tweenStatus(FlyIndicator, Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)) -- Smooth Crimson
        BodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        BodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
    end
end

local function toggleNoclip()
    Noclipping = not Noclipping
    if Noclipping then
        tweenStatus(NoclipIndicator, Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94))
        NoclipConnection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if Character and Noclipping then
                for _, part in ipairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
                        part.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        tweenStatus(NoclipIndicator, Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68))
        if NoclipConnection then
            NoclipConnection:Disconnect()
            NoclipConnection = nil
        end
    end
end

-- UI Component Connections
FlyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFly)
NoclipButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleNoclip)

SpeedInput.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local numericValue = tonumber(SpeedInput.Text)
    if numericValue then
        FlySpeed = numericValue
    else
        SpeedInput.Text = tostring(FlySpeed)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    KeysPressed[input.KeyCode] = true
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    KeysPressed[input.KeyCode] = nil
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not Flying or not RootPart then return end
    
    local cameraCFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
    local direction = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    
    if KeysPressed[Enum.KeyCode.W] then direction = direction + cameraCFrame.LookVector end
    if KeysPressed[Enum.KeyCode.S] then direction = direction - cameraCFrame.LookVector end
    if KeysPressed[Enum.KeyCode.A] then direction = direction - cameraCFrame.RightVector end
    if KeysPressed[Enum.KeyCode.D] then direction = direction + cameraCFrame.RightVector end
    if KeysPressed[Enum.KeyCode.Space] then direction = direction + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    if KeysPressed[Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] then direction = direction - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    
    BodyGyro.CFrame = cameraCFrame
    BodyVelocity.Velocity = direction.Unit * FlySpeed
    
    if direction == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) then
        BodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    end
end)
